inhomogeneous_deformation.parameter_convention: gb are ordinary commuting scalars; 'parity 1' labels the odd oscillator pair (b,a) they belong to, which is what makes [b,a] (odd) = gb * kappa (odd) parity-consistent.
inhomogeneous_deformation.coefficient_format: coeff maps gb symbol -> rational; gamma is linear in gb

central_component.description: Coefficient of kappa*K (= kappa) in [X,Y]_gamma: a scalar part that lies outside g (K=1 is not a basis element). Always attached to pairs with [X,Y] odd.

consistency.gamma_parity_rule: p(Z) = p(X) + p(Y) + 1 for every gamma_{XYZ} entry
consistency.cocycle: kappa-linear super Jacobi identity checked by src/C_gamma.py::check_cocycle
